Finding F-003: Potential underbilling on LOG-3003 for Meridian Freightways Inc (contract C-2003). A signed amendment changed the Unit Price, but billing kept the old price.

Scope: 15 invoice lines, 2024-10-25 to 2025-12-25. Potential underbilling: USD 82,107.94. Estimated recoverable: USD 77,674.11.

Basis: Clause AM1.1 (page 4) sets the price at USD 12.00 per unit. It replaces clause A.1 (page 3), which shows USD 11.25. Clause 4.2 (page 1) applies a 2.5% annual increase from 1 June 2025. Calculation: USD 12.00 (AM1) x (1 + 2.5%) [2025-06-01] = USD 12.30. Latest billed price: USD 11.53.

Recommended action (owner: Contract Administration): Load the amended Unit Price into the price master effective 2024-10-25. Confirm the amendment is countersigned. Then prepare a rebill for approval.

Approval is required from the billing manager and finance controller before any rebill is issued."}
